content.article: The Casino Welcome Bonus opens the bonus range at Longfu88: 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins, with 25x wagering on deposit plus bonus and 40x on Free Spins winnings. Anyone after the Longfu bonus also finds reloads and cashback below. The offers at Longfu88 are for players aged 18 or over, written for Malaysia.

Longfu88 Welcome Bonus and How to Claim It

The Casino Welcome Bonus at Longfu88 is a first-deposit offer of 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins. It requires a minimum first deposit of €50 and is meant for new registered players on their first qualifying deposit, with one welcome offer per account. The Live Casino Welcome Bonus gives 125% up to €888, while the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus gives 188% up to 2,888 USDT. Casino Welcome Bonus and Crypto Welcome Bonus are alternative first-deposit offers.

Claiming the bonus at Longfu88 takes four steps:

  1. Register an account and complete the required personal details.
  2. Make the first qualifying deposit.
  3. Activate the Casino Welcome Bonus in My Bonuses before placing any wagers.
  4. Play eligible casino games and complete the wagering before expiry.

The bonus is valid for 10 days from activation, so the player activates the Casino Welcome Bonus in My Bonuses before placing any wager.

Terms in Brief

These terms belong to the Casino Welcome Bonus at Longfu88. Wagering applies to the deposit plus the bonus amount, and separately to Free Spins winnings.

Term Value
Wagering 25x the deposit plus bonus amount
Free Spins wagering 40x Free Spins winnings
Validity 10 days from activation
Maximum bet €22.5 per spin
Maximum cashout 5x the initial bonus amount

Four rules can cost the bonus. Neteller and Skrill deposits are excluded from this promotion. Only one promotional bonus may be active at a time. A withdrawal request before claiming or while the bonus is active can void promotional eligibility. Account verification may be required before payment of promotional winnings.

Promo Code: What to Know

The Brand Information of the casino lists no Longfu88 promo code for its offers. Instead, My Bonuses activates each listed offer: the Casino Welcome Bonus before the first wager, and the other offers once their eligibility and deposit conditions are met. Players at Longfu88 therefore look in My Bonuses to activate an offer.

The weekend offers are valid for 7 days and the Double Fortune special for 24 hours. A reload cannot be combined with another active casino bonus.

Free Spins

Longfu88 attaches Free Spins to three offers. The Casino Weekly Reload gives 50 Free Spins for a minimum deposit of €30 and is valid for 7 days. A seasonal offer, Casino Trick or Treat Pumpkin Bonanza, gives up to 100 Free Spins from a minimum deposit of €20. Another 18 Free Spins come with the welcome bonus. Each set carries 40x wagering on the Free Spins winnings.

Weekly Cashback

The Casino Weekly Cashback at Longfu88 works as a rebate, returning up to 10% of weekly net casino losses, capped at €6,988. Losses are calculated from Monday 00:00 UTC through Sunday 23:59 UTC, and the minimum cashback is €4.5. Players opt in for a four-week cycle, and the cashback carries 10x wagering before withdrawal. Only real-money bets count, while bonus funds are excluded. The Live Casino Cashback pays 25% up to €850 with 10x wagering on the credited cashback.
